name: Cascadian Farm Rodale Institute U-pick
tagline: Rodale Institute PNW Organic Center at Cascadian Farm, Rockport, WA
description: Cascadian Farm Rodale Institute U-pick grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Pumpkins, and Corn in Rockport, WA. The farm is small, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
